description:
This process begins when a customer searches for a flight, train, or bus ticket.
After selecting the preferred route, date, and time, the customer provides personal information and payment details.
The booking system generates a ticket, which is sent to the customer via email or SMS.
The travel company updates its seat inventory accordingly.
Before travel, the customer may receive reminders and instructions for check-in or boarding.
The process concludes once the customer completes their journey, though post-travel feedback or services may extend it slightly.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_TicketBooking"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BookingDetails" name="Personal information, payment details, and selected journey"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TravelReminder" name="Travel reminders and check-in or boarding instructions"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel company" processRef="Process_TravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BookingDetails" name="Booking details and payment"
                      sourceRef="Task_ProvideDetails" targetRef="StartEvent_BookingRequest"
                      messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Ticket" name="Ticket by email or SMS"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket"
                      messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TravelReminder" name="Pre-travel reminders and instructions"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="Participant_Customer"
                      messageRef="Message_TravelReminder"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ticket booking and travel" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Customer">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Search</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SearchTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectRoute</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteJourney</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostTravel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PostTravel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_JourneyComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_PostTravelComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Search" name="Customer searches for a ticket">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SearchTicket" name="Search for a flight, train, or bus ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectRoute" name="Select preferred route, date, and time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideDetails" name="Provide personal information and payment details"
                   messageRef="Message_BookingDetails">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTicket" name="Receive ticket by email or SMS"
                      messageRef="Message_Ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteJourney" name="Complete journey">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostTravel" name="Post-travel feedback or services?" default="Flow_Customer_7">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostTravel" name="Provide post-travel feedback or use post-travel services">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_JourneyComplete" name="Journey complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_7</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PostTravelComplete" name="Post-travel activity complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Search" targetRef="Task_SearchTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_SearchTicket" targetRef="Task_SelectRoute"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SelectRoute" targetRef="Task_ProvideDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ProvideDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" targetRef="Task_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Gateway_PostTravel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravel" targetRef="EndEvent_JourneyComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_8" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravel" targetRef="Task_PostTravel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_9" sourceRef="Task_PostTravel" targetRef="EndEvent_PostTravelComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Travel company booking processing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_TravelCompany">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BookingSystem" name="Booking system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_BookingRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReminderChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendReminder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReminderMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_CompanyComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_TravelCompany" name="Travel company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateInventory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BookingRequest" name="Booking details received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BookingRequest" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicket" name="Send ticket to customer by email or SMS"
                   messageRef="Message_Ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderChoice" name="Send pre-travel reminders and instructions?" default="Flow_Company_6">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReminder" name="Send pre-travel reminders and check-in or boarding instructions"
                   messageRef="Message_TravelReminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderMerge" name="Reminder path complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CompanyComplete" name="Booking processing complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_8</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_BookingRequest" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_2" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Task_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_3" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_4" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_5" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderChoice" targetRef="Task_SendReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_6" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderChoice" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_7" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_8" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_CompanyComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
